tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Cisco C1200-24P-4G is a high-performance 24-port Gigabit Ethernet PoE+ managed switch designed for small to medium-sized businesses and enterprise networks. It offers reliable Layer 2 switching with advanced features, making it ideal for powering and connecting devices such as IP cameras, VoIP phones, wireless access points, and network endpoints.


Equipped with 24 Gigabit PoE+ ports (802.3at), this switch can deliver both data and power over a single Ethernet cable, simplifying deployment and reducing infrastructure costs. It also features 4 Gigabit SFP uplink ports, providing flexible fiber connectivity for long-distance network expansion.


The Cisco C1200 series ensures secure, scalable, and energy-efficient networking, with support for VLANs, QoS, Layer 2 switching, and enhanced security features. Its intuitive management interface allows easy configuration and monitoring, making it suitable for both IT professionals and growing businesses.


Key Features


  • 24 × Gigabit Ethernet PoE+ ports (802.3af/at)
  • 4 × Gigabit SFP uplink ports
  • High PoE power budget for multiple devices
  • Advanced Layer 2 switching features
  • Supports VLAN, QoS, IGMP Snooping
  • Secure network with port security & access control
  • Energy-efficient design
  • Easy web-based management interface
  • Ideal for SMB and enterprise deployments
